items.title: MUSLIM KEY YATIMON KI KUFAY MAI SHAHADA
items.body:
Muslim key Yatimon ki kufay mai Shahadat Hai

Sar Pito karo Matam yeh Waqt-e-Musibat Hai


<<DIVIDER>>


Baba Bhi Nahi Sar Par Aur Paas Nahi Maa bhi

Pardes Mai Bachon Par ye kaisi qayamat hai


<<DIVIDER>>

Faryad Karay Kissay, Kis say Kehan Dard Apna 

Bhukay Hai Akele Hai Aur Pyaas ki Shiddath Hai


<<DIVIDER>>


Kuch Rehem Nahi Khaya, Haris Ne Sitam Dhaya

Masoom Yatimon Par Ye Kaisi Musibath Hai


<<DIVIDER>>


Ek Bhai Ka Sar Kata Ek Bhai Ko Dikhla
Kar

Kya Dard Ka Manzar Hai Kaisi Yeh Kayamath Hai


<<DIVIDER>>

Haan Inki Shahadath Bhi Tamheed Hai Karbal Ki 

Inhi Bachon ka Matam Bhi Shabir ki Nusrath Hai


<<DIVIDER>>


Ab Pesh Karay Pursa Hum Bibi Rukhaiya ka 

Muslim ki Yatimee Par Ye Taza Musibath Hai


<<DIVIDER>>


Shazadoun ke Rauzon Par Hum Jakay padhe noha

Har dil Main Rasheed ab Toh Bas ek yahi Hasrath hai

items.title: aayi haatif ki aawaz sheh ko
items.body:
Aayi haatif ki aawaz sheh ko utro Shabbir ye karbala hai
Bas qadam ab na aage badhaao utro Shabbir ye karbala hai


<<DIVIDER>>

Ab safar qatm hai ibne Zahra, labe darya karo qaime barpa
Hashr tak hai yahi’n tumko rehna utro Shabbir ye karbala hai


<<DIVIDER>>

Yahi’n nau roz mehmaa’n rahoge, khaane peene ki eeza sahoge
Bhooke pyaase yahi’n qatl honge
utro Shabbir ye karbala hai


<<DIVIDER>>

Marte dam bhi na paani milega, pyaasi gardan pa qanjar chalega
Sar tumhara sina par chadega 
utro Shabbir ye karbala hai


<<DIVIDER>>

Laash chaalees din tak tumhari, Is hi jungle me uryaa’n rahegi
Rone waala bhi koi na hoga
utro Shabbir ye karbala hai


<<DIVIDER>>

Khaaegi jab sakina tamaacha, yahi’n tadpega laasha tumhara
Shimr dega yahi’n usko eeza utro Shabbir ye karbala hai

<<DIVIDER>>

Raahwaar apna sarwar ne roka, utre baaqar wahi’n shaahe waala
Haatife ghaib jis dam pukaara utro Shabbir ye karbala hai
